name: Dracul Tremblay
source:
Dracul is a rather loud and eccentric individual, always trying to pick up other's mood and lead them. He's a very natural leader and while he can be very annoying occasionally, he's annoying in a way that some may find charming. He currently holds the world record for the sheer amount of D&D campaigns that he has run.

Seems to have a sort of inferiority complex as he believes his talent isn't as useful as some others are. He's scared his normal life is so boring and tiring, so he tries to act like some of the character's he's used in his campaigns to be more interesting. But that fear of being dull is ever present.

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CYmkp7uNWkp/]official description[/url]]
